# Test that GO111MODULE=auto starts in module mode and re-execs the go command
# with GO111MODULE=off when no module or workspace is found and module mode is
# not forced.

env GO111MODULE=auto

# Outside a module or workspace, GO111MODULE=auto re-execs with GO111MODULE=off.
go env GO111MODULE
stdout '^off$'
go env GOMOD
! stdout .

# Also verify with GODEBUG=gotoolchainexec=0 (subprocess fallback path).
env GODEBUG=gotoolchainexec=0
go env GO111MODULE
stdout '^off$'
env GODEBUG=

# Inside a module, GO111MODULE=auto stays in module mode without re-execing.
cd $WORK/mod
go env GO111MODULE
stdout '^auto$'
go env GOMOD
stdout 'mod[/\\]go\.mod$'

# Using -C from outside a module into a module stays in module mode.
cd $GOPATH/src
go -C $WORK/mod env GO111MODULE
stdout '^auto$'
go env -C $WORK/mod GO111MODULE
stdout '^auto$'

# Inside a workspace (without a go.mod in cwd), GO111MODULE=auto stays in module mode.
cd $WORK/ws
go env GO111MODULE
stdout '^auto$'
go env GOWORK
stdout 'ws[/\\]go\.work$'
env GOWORK=off
go env GO111MODULE
stdout '^off$'
env GOWORK=

# Setting GO111MODULE=auto via go/env file also re-execs with "off" outside a module.
env GOENV=$WORK/goenv
env GO111MODULE=
go env -w GO111MODULE=auto
cd $GOPATH/src
go env GO111MODULE
stdout '^off$'
cd $WORK/mod
go env GO111MODULE
stdout '^auto$'
env GOENV=
env GO111MODULE=auto

# Commands that force module mode outside a module stay in module mode.
mkdir $WORK/newmod
cd $WORK/newmod
go mod init example.com/newmod
exists go.mod

mkdir $WORK/newwork
cd $WORK/newwork
go work init
exists go.work

cd $GOPATH/src
! go get rsc.io/quote
stderr '''go get'' is no longer supported outside a module'

! go mod edit -fmt
stderr 'go\.mod file not found'

go mod edit -print $WORK/mod/go.mod
stdout '^module example\.com/mod$'

go doc rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2
stdout 'package quote'

go install -v rsc.io/fortune@v1.0.0
exists $GOPATH/bin/fortune$GOEXE

# Child processes spawned by 'go run' see GO111MODULE=auto inside a module and
# GO111MODULE=off after re-execing outside a module.
cd $WORK/mod
go run ./printenv.go
stdout '^GO111MODULE=auto$'
cd $GOPATH/src
cp $WORK/mod/printenv.go $GOPATH/src/printenv.go
go run printenv.go
stdout '^GO111MODULE=off$'

-- $WORK/mod/go.mod --
module example.com/mod

go 1.21
-- $WORK/mod/printenv.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Printf("GO111MODULE=%s\n", os.Getenv("GO111MODULE"))
}
-- $WORK/ws/go.work --
go 1.21

use ../mod
